title: Learning to Decode Linear Codes with Generalized Belief Propagation Network
abstract: arXiv:2611.06874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Error correcting codes are a fundamental component of communication systems, enabling reliable data transmission over noisy channels. Recently, neural decoders have demonstrated notable performance gains over classical iterative algorithms. In this paper, we propose a Generalized Belief Propagation Network (GBPNet) that preserves message-passing symmetry while enhancing the decoder's learning capability. The architecture uses cascaded variable-node updates and learned element-wise message scaling while retaining the Tanner graph structure. We also introduce two training strategies, progressive training and high-SNR training, that improve decoding accuracy. Experimental results on several linear codes show that GBPNet achieves lower bit error rates than conventional belief propagation and the evaluated state-of-the-art neural decoders.

translated_title: 基于广义信念传播网络的线性码学习译码方法
translated_abstract: 纠错码是通信系统的基本组成部分，能够在噪声信道上实现可靠的数据传输。近年来，神经译码器相比经典迭代算法展现出了显著的性能提升。本文提出了一种广义信念传播网络，它在保留消息传递对称性的同时增强了译码器的学习能力。该架构采用级联的变量节点更新和可学习的逐元素消息缩放，同时保持Tanner图结构不变。我们还引入了两种训练策略——渐进式训练和高信噪比训练——以提升译码精度。在多种线性码上的实验结果表明，GBPNet相比传统信念传播算法以及所评估的最先进神经译码器取得了更低的误码率。
tldr: 本文提出广义信念传播网络GBPNet，在保持消息传递对称性和Tanner图结构的前提下，通过级联变量节点更新、可学习消息缩放以及渐进式和高信噪比训练策略，实现了优于传统信念传播算法和现有最先进神经译码器的误码率性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GBPNet, a generalized belief propagation network that preserves message-passing symmetry while enhancing learning capability, achieving lower bit error rates than conventional belief propagation and state-of-the-art neural decoders.
